question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting clockwise around a circular table, facing the center in the same sequence at equal distances between them. If W is sitting in the north direction, then in which direction is Q sitting?
solution:

Given information: All are sitting clockwise around a circular table, facing the center in the same sequence at equal distances between them. If W is sitting in the north direction.

Sitting arrangement is given according to given data,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/132843f72ce708ef245cc9e9461d0c375a0d662a538d1ed19342163f85d78a73.png]
